topic: Materials That Absorb, Float, Sink, Decay
key_concepts: Matter exists as solid, liquid, or gas.
Materials can be classified by their ability to absorb water.
Absorb means to take in liquid in a natural or gradual way.
Porous materials have small holes that allow air or liquid to pass through.
Porous materials are also called absorbent materials.
Non-porous materials do not allow air or liquid to pass through.
Cotton is very porous and naturally absorbs water.
Plastic is non-porous and does not allow water to pass through.
Materials can be classified by their ability to float or sink in water.
Sink means to fall to the bottom of water; float means to stay on top.
